AGENDA
  YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Tuesday, April 25, 2023
  6:30 P.M.
  The three-fold mission of the Youth & Family Action Committee is:
  1. To support positive activities and opportunities for young people;
  2. To strengthen families; and
  3. To combat the problems of substance abuse.
